actualNative.description: The unchanged original firmware completes the SFDP capability query, then reaches an unimplemented PCR SEC_CONF read. Diagnostic guest fixtures establish ordinary watchdog behavior separately.

contracts: Bus publishes ordinary watchdog sources58/60 and marks IRQ inputs dirty when a real stage event changes their levels; next_deadline includes IRQ and reset deadlines. No host feed or interrupt injection.

Joint fixed-size LP/TIMG previews select the earliest reset, use TRM priority only at equal timestamps, and commit real controllers only through the winning timestamp. The module resolves equal TG0/TG1 to cause7. Cause8 and event time are preserved.

A TG1 WFI diagnostic guest in plain and UnitCost modes wakes through source60 to CPUline1/id17 with non-vectored CLIC. Its real handler unlocks, writes FEED, clears RAW, locks and executes mret. It does not prove factory SHV, CPU24 panic, original FreeRTOS, or a TG0 guest handler.

Ordinary TG0 qualification requires a real committed cold FLASHBOOT clear; group reset alone cannot grant it. Functional gating pauses phase; APB closure blocks MMIO without stopping the timer. Clear does not feed.

CPU reset preserves TIMG; Core/HP clears it and retains LP. A deliberately late Core8@25 is followed after reboot by independently retained SWD12@228000000, rather than advancing LP past the early reset before it is applied.

In the strict TIMG profile, exact owned-word refusal is Unsupported/ModelLimit, not fabricated cause5/7. Plain/UnitCost negative guests preserve trap CSRs, destination, exception count and controller state for locked IRQ clear, unowned timer enablebit, active unsupported source and APB-closed RAW read. Adjacent unknown6c and off-profile mapping remain unchanged.
SFDP byte32=f3 is the published XMC C-series digital response, not forced successful capability flags. Input originals are unchanged.

negativeResults.description: New fixture initially failed compilation: Vec<usize> was compared to Vec<u32>; fixed expected integer type without production change.

408 tests passed, two new fixtures failed: an unmodeled run budget of1 does not skip239999 idle cycles, and late Core reset must retain the later LP SWD timeline. Fixture expectations corrected; production chronology unchanged.
480 tests passed before independent review found model refusal mapped to an architectural TIMG access fault; passing result did not cover that missing causal distinction.
Warnings-denied Clippy rejected needless_range_loop in the new fixture; replaced with BASE.into_iter().enumerate().

limits: Focused LTO=false checks are not the final full default-LTO workspace CI or production WASM/browser/CPU acceptance.
Original execution remains before app_main/LCD/buttons/TF and before ordinary watchdog initialization. No RF/PHY, physical clock/reset-pulse or complete product support claim.
Read-only trace PCs record bounded observations without Bus reads/writes, instruction/stop changes or PC mutation. Raw logs, private paths and unrelated system details are excluded.

reviews.scope: Independent read-only Bus/Soc/owner/fixture review; one model-refusal-to-architectural-fault P2 repaired and verified against source fingerprints and481-test logs; no remaining P1/P2 in the scoped glue. No independent execution or final product acceptance.
